description: Purchasable catalog: 24 music SKUs ($0.05–$299.00 USDC: downloads, zines, sample packs, podcast music beds, memberships, licenses), 2 data endpoints ($0.05 USDC each: ISS pass predictions, webpage summaries), and voluntary tip routes (USDC/BTC — not purchases). Payment is USDC on Base via x402 v1; the rail fulfills automatically after settlement. Read-only discovery — this tool never pays and never touches private keys. Use qm_buy (or qm_data_iss_pass / qm_data_summarize) to get the live 402 payment challenge for a specific item. Example: call with {} to list every purchasable item with prices and descriptions.
name: qm_catalog
